summary: Upgrade a pipx-installed Ansible to the latest release with pipx upgrade --include-injected ansible.
questions: How do I upgrade Ansible installed with pipx?
Will pipx upgrade also update injected packages?

answer_card.title: Upgrade Ansible with pipx
answer_card.answer_md:
```console
pipx upgrade --include-injected ansible
```
`--include-injected` also upgrades packages you injected, like `argcomplete`.
